overloadMerges.semanticRole: Create a new collection, optionally prefilled with one or more values passed as parameters; omitting all parameters creates an empty collection.
overloadMerges.note: Mechanical parser could not locate a top-level '(...)' list because the whole parameter list is itself optional ('{( ...value : any )}'), so the draft had zero params. Replaced with a single-member variadic group (0..n) for 'value', matching the doc's '...value' repeat notation.
